grids.storefront_promo: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (Bento style for banners)
grids.product_list: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6

layouts.storefront: Top Navigation (Sticky) -> Hero/Banners -> Left Sidebar (Filters) + Right Content (Products) -> Generous Footer
layouts.admin_panel: Collapsible Left Sidebar -> Top Nav (User/Notifications) -> Dashboard Content (F-pattern prioritizing KPIs)
layouts.checkout: Focused checkout layout (minimal nav) to prevent distractions
layouts.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for standard padding inside cards, p-4 for high-density admin tables.

accessibility.contrast: APCA and WCAG AA compliance. Ensure text on primary button is white, and text on warning is black.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-label for icon buttons. aria-hidden=true for decorative elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.alerts: sonner (for real-time notifications like PIX received)

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2D layout transitions and micro-interactions. No complex 3D required to keep checkout and admin fast and accessible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing strictly on the provided Next.js/React + FastAPI + MongoDB architecture, adapted from Node/PostgreSQL.
Implement CPF Login and Registration cleanly with validation.
Implement two main categories for products: 'Produtos de Ativação' (Activation) and 'Produtos de Créditos' (Credits).
Cart logic: Activation items allow ONLY 1 unit. You CANNOT mix Activation and Credit products in the same cart. Credit items can have multiple quantities.
Implement PIX integration: Display QR Code clearly on checkout, provide a 'Copiar Código' button, and use 'sonner' to toast when payment is confirmed via webhook.
Admin Dashboard must have F-pattern layout, showing metrics (Users, Orders, Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Annual Revenue) prominently.
Include a specific view for WhatsApp Baileys integration: QR code scan, session status, and message templates ({nome}, {cpf}, etc).
Ensure the store is fully responsive (desktop, tablet, mobile, smart TV), utilizing Tailwind grid classes.
All text and currencies must be localized to pt-BR (R$).
Include specific custom fields per product type: MAC, Email, Senha, Login, Chave, Serial, Código, Token, Licença, Observações.
Use data-testid on every button, input, and critical UI element for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
Always add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
